hero:
Use case: stylized-concept. PRODUCTION 2D ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS, transparent background, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, 8 equal-sized cells, each containing the SAME original pig-in-a-minecart game character facing RIGHT. No labels, text, frame borders, ground, shadow, glow or background. This will be used as actual game sprites, not concept art. Each character is fully contained in its own cell with transparent padding; no overlap, no crop. Cart body exactly same width and height in all 8 cells, same lower baseline, consistent side-on orthographic view. IMPORTANT: DO NOT DRAW WHEELS; wheels will be animated separately. The bottom edge of the cart body is a straight axle mount, leave room below it.

Art direction: exceptionally appealing professionally hand-drawn 2D animation, original small indie game mascot with intentional designed shapes, polished cel coloring with delicate painted light and fine hand-inked deep midnight-blue contours. Not geometric vector primitives, not crude, not 3D, not plastic, not pixel art. Pig is a very cute small warm peach-pink piglet, plump round head, soft floppy rounded asymmetric ears (one folds at tip), small protruding rounded snout with tiny nostrils, two close-set dark warm expressive eyes with subtle catchlights, small cheek blush, tiny curled forelock, little smile; NO angry eyebrows, no creepy giant human eyes, no long rat muzzle, no pointy fox ears. Tiny dark cocoa hooves grip the cart rim. Rich vermilion-red little neckerchief trails LEFT. Character has unmistakable pig identity and looks charming at small gameplay scale.

Cart: beautifully drawn simple golden ochre wooden mine-cart tub with a few horizontal wood planks, restrained warm highlights, dark midnight metal reinforced rim and corner brackets, small brass rivets, slightly rounded worn corners, rich material without clutter. SAME cart throughout. No wheels anywhere in atlas. Cartoon side profile, no extreme perspective.

Frames, reading left to right across top row then bottom:
1. RIDE A: relaxed alert happy pig, neutral cart, scarf streams left.
2. RIDE B: same riding pose, ears bounce a little and cheek smile, scarf gently higher.
3. RIDE C: riding with a natural half-blink, tiny body bob, scarf lower.
4. RIDE D: same ride, bright open eyes, one ear flutters, slight grin.
5. ANTICIPATION: pig crouches low into tub, hooves braced on rim, ears tilt back, cart body unchanged.
6. JUMP / RISE: pig lifts happily above rim, cheeks and ears rising, scarf and hooves react, cart body unchanged.
7. FALL / STOMP: pig leans forward expectantly and holds rim, ears lag upward, scarf arcs up-left, cart unchanged.
8. LAND / SQUASH: pig soft and compressed low into tub after landing, eyes pleasantly squinted, ears spread softly, scarf follows through, cart unchanged.

Consistency is crucial: pig identity, pink color, scarf, cart outline and cart size identical across all frames; only pose and scarf/ears/mouth change. Every cell occupied by one whole pig plus cart without wheels. Generous padding, clean genuine transparency, all 8 usable sprites.
enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual 2D game animation sprite atlas with genuine TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal padded cells, no text, no labels, no floor, no shadows or scenery. Same polished fine midnight-blue hand-inked, gentle painterly cel style as pig/cart reference. NO PIG OR CART in this image: only two enemy types with four frames each. Top row: SAME cute squat apple-green mine SLIME in four frames, a rounded gelatinous blob with two small dark expressive eyes, little smirk and tiny pale yellow-green highlight, slightly translucent rim, not scary. Frame1 normal at rest; frame2 taller soft bounce; frame3 slightly wider low bounce; frame4 comically flattened after getting stomped, dazed harmless little eyes, no gore. Bottom row: SAME short squat purple armoured mine BEETLE facing LEFT in four walking frames, friendly rival expression, indigo shell, exactly THREE cream triangular spikes on back with consistent placement, six tiny warm ochre feet, expressive two eyes, no antenna clutter. Feet alternate in 4-step walking cycle, shell silhouette consistent and stable. Every sprite fully contained in its cell with large transparent padding, same lower baseline within each row, zero overlap between cells. Color/identity/size consistent across all poses. Suitable as actual readable 64-pixel-high enemy sprites scaled down in a side-view runner. Artistically refined cartoon details, organic curves, strong readable silhouette, no plastic 3D, no pixel art, no crude geometric construction.
props: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual 2D side-view GAME PROP ATLAS on genuine transparent background. Exactly THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal padded cells, SIX separate objects, no labels/text/borders/shadows/scene. Match the provided character's refined midnight-blue hand-inked and gently painted cel art, warm highlights, restrained small details, original charming indie game art. All shapes orthographic SIDE VIEW, not 3D perspective. TOP LEFT: one golden yellow APPLE with a tiny green leaf, crisp dark navy contour and warm highlight, easy to read at 24px. TOP MIDDLE: one square worn warm ochre WOODEN CRATE with diagonal timber brace, navy reinforced corners and four subtle rivets; no text. TOP RIGHT: one small antique amber mine LANTERN hanging from a little loop, thick dark metal frame, warm yellow luminous glass, NO diffuse glow outside silhouette (will be added in game). BOTTOM LEFT: one perfectly CIRCULAR mine-cart WHEEL, straight orthographic view, dark midnight-blue steel rim, warm bronze hub and six readable short spokes, no perspective ellipse, isolated and symmetrical. BOTTOM MIDDLE: one irregular wide flat polygonal BLUE SLATE ROCK BLOCK, navy outline, subtle cool grey-blue painted bevels, low detail, suitable for repeating as a 2D cave foreground tile. BOTTOM RIGHT: a DIFFERENT variation of the same wide BLUE SLATE ROCK BLOCK with slightly different corners and muted teal mineral vein; same material and scale. The two blocks are individual isolated stones, not piles. Each object entirely within own cell, large transparent padding, no background or ground, no extra props. Professional game art sprites that remain crisp and consistent with the pig/cart reference when scaled down.
pipeline: Original transparent atlases are unchanged. Read-only image analysis measures frame regions and chassis pivots. Godot animates poses, chassis springs and independent wheels; preview frames rendered in Godot and encoded as GIF/MP4.
